children: RH reported results for the 2026 quarter with revenue of $922.15M, net income of $60.17M and diluted EPS of $3.06, each higher versus the prior-year quarter.
¹ Reported as “Net revenues”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted net income per share”.
Revenue growth was driven by hospitality operations and new Design Gallery openings, supporting modest consolidated net revenue gains.
RH continued a product transformation highlighted by its largest new-product launch in company history (RH Estates and multiple collections).
Global expansion accelerated with new Galleries in Milan, London and Paris and expanded hospitality experiences including restaurants, wine bars and Guesthouse development.
Gross margin improved materially from tariff refunds and favorable product mix; however, new openings increased occupancy and pre-opening operating costs.
